statements.statement: The patient has been diagnosed with syncope and near-syncope accompanied by palpitations
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia (R55, I47.1)
The diagnosis codes R55 and I47.1 were submitted
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
A 48-hour Holter monitoring study is medically necessary to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity and guide further management
